get: Retrieves the current value of a setting.
reset: Resets this server or global setting to its default values.
inheritGlobal: Manages whether to inherit global settings.
inheritGlobal-enable: Set to true to inherit global settings, set to false to not inherit.
mute: Prevents the bot from reacting to you entering and leaving voice channels.
mute-enable: Set to true to mute, set to false to unmute.
prefix: Manages the prefix for voice messages.
prefix-set: Sets the prefix for voice messages.
prefix-set-value: The specific value to set as the prefix.
prefix-join: Manages the prefix when a user joins a voice channel.
prefix-join-set: Sets the prefix when a user joins a voice channel.
prefix-join-set-value: The specific value to set as the prefix when a user joins a voice channel.
prefix-join-unset: Clears the set prefix value when a user joins a voice channel.
prefix-leave: Manages the prefix when a user leaves a voice channel.
prefix-leave-set: Sets the prefix when a user leaves a voice channel.
prefix-leave-set-value: The specific value to set as the prefix when a user leaves a voice channel.
prefix-leave-unset: Clears the set prefix value when a user leaves a voice channel.
message-set-value: The specific value to set as the general voice message.
message-unset: Clears the set general voice message.
message-join: Manages the message when a user joins a voice channel.
message-join-set: Sets the message when a user joins a voice channel.
message-join-set-value: The specific message value to set when a user joins a voice channel.
message-join-unset: Clears the set message when a user joins a voice channel.
message-leave: Manages the message when a user leaves a voice channel.
message-leave-set: Sets the message when a user leaves a voice channel.
message-leave-set-value: The specific message value to set when a user leaves a voice channel.
message-leave-unset: Clears the set message when a user leaves a voice channel.
suffix: Manages the suffix for voice messages.
suffix-set: Sets the suffix for voice messages.
suffix-set-value: The specific value to set as the suffix.
suffix-join: Manages the suffix when a user joins a voice channel.
suffix-join-set: Sets the suffix when a user joins a voice channel.
suffix-join-set-value: The specific value to set as the suffix when a user joins a voice channel.
suffix-join-unset: Clears the set suffix value when a user joins a voice channel.
suffix-leave: Manages the suffix when a user leaves a voice channel.
suffix-leave-set: Sets the suffix when a user leaves a voice channel.
suffix-leave-set-value: The specific value to set as the suffix when a user leaves a voice channel.
suffix-leave-unset: Clears the set suffix value when a user leaves a voice channel.
language: Manages the language used for the bot's voice.
language-set: Sets the language for the bot's voice.
language-set-value: The specific language value to set.
language-join: Manages the language setting when a user joins a voice channel.
language-join-set: Sets the language when a user joins a voice channel.
language-join-set-value: The specific language value to set when a user joins a voice channel.
language-join-unset: Clears the set language when a user joins a voice channel.
language-leave: Manages the language setting when a user leaves a voice channel.
language-leave-set: Sets the language when a user leaves a voice channel.
language-leave-set-value: The specific language value to set when a user leaves a voice channel.
language-leave-unset: Clears the set language when a user leaves a voice channel.
voice: Manages the voice model used for the bot's voice.
voice-set: Sets the voice model for the bot's voice.
voice-set-value: The specific voice model value to set.
voice-unset: Clears the set voice model value.
voice-join: Manages the voice model setting when a user joins a voice channel.
voice-join-set: Sets the voice model when a user joins a voice channel.
voice-join-set-value: The specific voice model value to set when a user joins a voice channel.
voice-join-unset: Clears the set voice model when a user joins a voice channel.
voice-leave: Manages the voice model setting when a user leaves a voice channel.
voice-leave-set: Sets the voice model when a user leaves a voice channel.
voice-leave-set-value: The specific voice model value to set when a user leaves a voice channel.
voice-leave-unset: Clears the set voice model when a user leaves a voice channel.
